page.overview:
Who is Draconid people?

The Draconid people are one of the first two groups of people in the Hoenn region. They make their first appearance in Pokémon Omega Ruby and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire. The Draconid people were one of the first inhabitants of the Hoenn region.

They were a tribe consisting of -type Pokémon Trainers who lived in Meteor Falls. During their time in the falls, meteors fell from the sky and the two Legendary Pokémon Groudon and Kyogre fought in their Primal forms until Rayquaza descended from the sky and stopped them.

One-thousand years later, when a meteor struck Hoenn, Groudon and Kyogre were awakened once again and fought. The Lorekeeper of the Draconid people bearing the Key Stone wished for Rayquaza to return in order to stop the enraged Pokémon.

Rayquaza descended once more and, due to the wish, was able to Mega Evolve and battle both Legendary Pokémon, causing them to return to the depths of the earth and sea. Filled with gratitude, the Draconid people built and decorated the Sky Pillar so that they could call to their Pokémon savior. After another thousand years, the Draconid people predicted an approaching meteoroid that would strike the Pokémon world and they planned for Rayquaza to once again save them.
